title: SlimStat video tutorials catalog, version 1
description: Served at https://wp-slimstat.com/videos/videos.json and read by SlimStat > Videos in the WordPress admin. The plugin validates every entry on its own and skips the ones that do not match; it also ignores fields it does not know, so fields may be added without bumping the version. Never change the meaning of a field in place: a breaking change gets a new file name.

version.description: Schema version. The plugin rejects the whole file unless this is exactly the number 1.

categories.description: Optional. Orders the category rows and adds new ones. The eight built-in ids keep the plugin's translated labels, so their title here is used only for ids the plugin does not know. At most 50 are read.

title.description: Row heading for a category the plugin does not know. Without one, its videos are listed under More videos.

order.description: Rows are sorted by this, lowest first. Built-in rows default to 10, 20 ... 80 in the order listed in docs/video-tutorials/README.md; new rows default to 1000.

videos.description: At most 500 are read. Within a row, videos are sorted by order, then newest first, then by title.

id.description: Permanent and unique. The new-video marker tracks ids, so changing one makes the video new again for everyone, and reusing one hides a new video.

title.description: Plain text. Markup is shown literally, never rendered.

slug.description: The watch page is https://wp-slimstat.com/videos/{slug}/. The plugin builds this link itself; the catalog cannot point anywhere else.

youtubeId.description: For the watch page's player. The plugin never contacts YouTube, but skips a video without a valid id, as the website does.

thumbnail.description: https://wp-slimstat.com/... or a root-relative path such as /images/videos/overview.webp. Anything else (another host, http, a YouTube thumbnail) is replaced by a placeholder, so the admin never requests images from YouTube.

category.description: A built-in category id or one listed in categories. Unknown ids go to More videos.

published.description: A date (2026-11-03) or a date-time with Z or an offset (2026-11-03T09:05:58+00:00). A video counts as new only when it is published within a week before the user's baseline or later.

order.description: Position in its row, lowest first. Defaults to 1000.

duration.description: Optional. Shown on the thumbnail, e.g. 1:47.

description.description: Optional. Plain text, shown in two lines under the title.
